name: niimblue-mcp
description: Design NIIMBOT labels, see NiimBlue's exact 1-bit print preview, save fill-in templates, and open them in NiimBlue to print.

chrome_path.title: Chrome or Edge executable
chrome_path.description: Leave empty to find Google Chrome, Chromium or Microsoft Edge in the usual install folders. The preview renders in it headlessly.

app_url.title: NiimBlue URL
app_url.description: The NiimBlue web app the label link opens (http or https).

templates_dir.title: Templates folder
templates_dir.description: Where render_label save_as writes label templates. Leave empty for Documents/NiimBlue Templates in your home folder.

fonts_dir.title: Font folder
fonts_dir.description: Extra label fonts (.woff2, .ttf or .otf; the family is the file name up to the first dot). Read only. Leave empty for Documents/NiimBlue Fonts in your home folder.
